From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding credits request — Aurora AI

Jordan — did a quick look into the audit. Key signals:
- ~18 signups tied to aurora-ai.io in the last 24 hrs, but 11 are from MX-controlled subdomains (demo.*, staging.*).
- IP fingerprints show a mix: 60% from a cloud provider range (expectable), 40% from residential/proxy ASN that historically spikes during fraud waves.
- Several user-agent strings are identical across accounts, and we observed repeated device fingerprints (cookie hash).

I've attached a snippet of the SRE logs showing the signup bursts. My recommendation: hold full credit issuance until we get either a corporate email domain confirmation from procurement or a short demo/video call proving legitimate usage. If they can provide a corporate contact on aurora-ai.io (POC + company registration), we can fast-track.

Ben Carter
Risk & Trust, Redwood Inference
attachments: sre_log_snippet.txt (text/plain)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Ava Ross <ava@aurora-ai.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding credits request — Aurora AI

Thanks — +1 on holding the full grant until we confirm. Policy note: per PLG credit policy section 4.2, when multiple accounts are created from subdomain patterns and matching device fingerprints we require one of the following for manual override:
- Signed procurement email from a corporate address at the domain (procurement@aurora-ai.io is fine), or
- A short recorded demo verifying product usage and company footprint, or
- Legal company registration (screenshot / link).

Operationally, we can provision a partial allowance (25% of the onboarding credits) to unblock development while we wait for docs. Jordan — if you can get procurement confirmation we can move to full release same day.

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Sales Ops & Compliance, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
